heading: Your
lede: A private place for longer writing, apart from the evening questionnaire. Its entries never enter your scores. A mood you attach only counts in the mood tracker.
title: Title
empty: Nothing here yet. Write the first entry whenever you feel like it: there is no schedule and nothing to fill in.
foot: A journal is for you: no streaks, no counters, no reminders.
moodHint: Optional. It counts toward your mood average, with less weight than the mood of the day.
invalid: Please check the day and the text.
prompt.1: What is on your mind right now?
prompt.2: What went well today, even if it was small?
prompt.3: What did you find hard, and what did it teach you?
prompt.4: What are you grateful for today?
prompt.5: What would you tell yourself a year ago?
prompt.6: What are you avoiding, and why?
prompt.7: What do you want more of in the coming days?
prompt.8: Describe the day as if telling a friend.
